status: partial implementation; not versioned or published as 1.71
implementation: Each cryptographically random token is bound immutably to its authenticated Client. Production login and successful resume issue an owner-bound token; rotation still revokes the previous token.

All six production transport-closure stores now use one atomic first-closure timestamp before publishing the closed flag. Hub, read pump, queue closure and administration audit-failure closure cannot renew the five-minute grace.

Long connected play does not expire a resume-only token. Attempts against a still-open owner cannot consume it. Once transport closes, the existing five-minute resume allowance begins; the exact deadline rejects further use.

Token validation rejects an already authenticated different account before consuming the owner token. Existing newer-owner, work-lock, moderation, audit and character-recovery admission checks remain in place.
Character cleanup marks disconnection using the same first-closure clock. A 30-second sweep removes expired closed-owner tokens without pruning live-owner tokens or deleting a newer account index.

No wire token format, password hash, trusted administrator role, account data, casino money or independent fifteen-minute saved dungeon progress policy change. Tokens remain process-local and restart requires ordinary login.

tests.result: Passed, eidolon-server package 2.694 seconds; clean git diff --check.
tests.newCases: Nine bounded in-process token/closure tests: 100-hour trusted-clock active-play probe followed by real token consumption; first-write closure; exact expiry; rotation/new owner; 32 concurrent consumers with one winner; wrong authenticated account retaining the owner token; sweeping; invalid owner/unknown closure rejection; actual cleanup using the original closure; 32 closure observers preserving first-write time.
tests.scope: Real CSPRNG tokens and actual in-memory token mutex/cleanup operations. Fake trusted server times avoid long sleeps. Cleanup uses a fresh local audit journal and fake store, no database, and seals fixture background work to avoid delivering presence. This is not live or connected long-session acceptance.
tests.retainedCoverage: Existing queue-close producer races, immutable character binding, account-work ordering, stale cleanup, audit-failure disconnection preservation and protected admin admission passed with the change.
tests.assemblyHistory: Initial compile caught a missing time import for the atomic timestamp; corrected it. Earlier focused race checks passed in 2.364 and 2.438 seconds before the final wrong-account fence. Counts and scopes overlap and are not additive.

remaining1_71: Authentication abuse across fresh connections and bounded credential/hash work; review actual trusted proxy identity before using an IP key.
Credential boundary review without silently locking out existing accounts.

Owner choice of email versus operator-assisted password recovery, with verified ownership requirements for legacy unverified email. No SMTP integration or administrator password-reset/grant bypass has been added.
